dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: My wife lives in the city, while my daughter lives with her grandparents — my parents — in Mt. Qingce.

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: So what does that make me? Good question. I'm not sure I have a good answer.

dialogues.speaker: Zhonglin
dialogues.text: Speaking of origins... Where do you come from?
